# Worksheet CC_DEV_019

## Facts from the documents
- Policy AS/2026/320305/49 (Imran S. Khan), individual, SI 2,50,000, CB 0, period 10-Jan-2026 to 09-Jan-2027, continuous since 10-Jan-2024.
- Admission 20-Aug-2026, discharge 22-Aug-2026 = 2 days, 2 room-days billed. Right inguinal hernia, lap TEP with mesh.

## Eligibility checks
- Continuous cover since 10-Jan-2024; admission 20-Aug-2026 is 2 years 7 months later. Hernia 24-month specific waiting period (6.3 i.12) ended 09-Jan-2026 -> completed; claim admissible.
- Admission within policy period 10-Jan-2026 to 09-Jan-2027 (Clause 2).

## Limits (Clause 4.1(i), 4.1(ii))
- Room rent cap = min(2% x SI 250,000.00, 5,000) = 5,000.00 per day
- ICU cap = min(5% x SI 250,000.00, 10,000) = 10,000.00 per day
- Sum insured used for these % limits is the base SI in the schedule (Clause 3.47 defines SI separately from Cumulative Bonus).

## Proportionate deduction ratio (Clause 4.1 Note 2; DECISIONS #1, #2)
- No room/ICU line exceeds its cap -> no proportionate deduction (ratio = 1).

## Bill lines
| # | Item | Billed | Treatment | Clause | Admissible before proportion |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| 1 | Deluxe twin sharing - room rent | 9,600.00 | Room 2 d x 4,800.00 ; cap 5,000.00 /day -> eligible 9,600.00 | 4.1(i) | 9,600.00 |
| 2 | Surgeon fee | 33,750.00 | Payable | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 33,750.00 |
| 3 | Anaesthetist fee | 10,000.00 | Payable | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 10,000.00 |
| 4 | OT charges | 16,150.00 | Payable | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 16,150.00 |
| 5 | Prolene mesh 15x15 | 12,050.00 | Payable | 4.1(iv) implant | 12,050.00 |
| 6 | Pharmacy | 6,950.00 | Payable (medicines) | 4.1(iv); 4.1 Note 2 | 6,950.00 |
| 7 | Consumables | 5,250.00 | Payable | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 5,250.00 |
| 8 | USG, blood work, ECG | 3,300.00 | Payable | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 3,300.00 |
| 9 | Discharge procedure charges | 470.00 | Not payable: List II item 30 - subsumed into room charges | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| 10 | Documentation charges | 280.00 | Not payable: List II item 29 - subsumed into room charges | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| 11 | Attendant food | 1,200.00 | Not payable: List I items 9 / 24 (food other than patient diet; attendant charges) | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| | **Total billed/claimed** | **99,000.00** | | | **97,050.00** |

- Check: hospital lines sum to 99,000.00 vs bill grand total 99,000.00 -> agree
- Total claimed (hospital + other bills) = 99,000.00

## Step results
1. Room/ICU excess over caps (4.1(i)/(ii)): 0.00
2. Non-payable / subsumed items (4.7, Annexure A; 4.1.1(v); 4.5): 1,950.00
3. Proportionate deduction: nil
4. Admissible before sub-limit/co-pay = 97,050.00
5. Sub-limits: none applicable
6. Co-payment 5% (Clause 9.3; DECISIONS #3, on admissible after all deductions/sub-limits): 97,050.00 x 5% = 4,852.50 -> 4,853
7. Net after co-pay = 92,197.00
8. Sum insured + CB this policy year = 250,000.00; earlier claims paid 0.00 / admitted 0.00 -> available 250,000.00 (by paid) / 250,000.00 (by admitted) (Clause 2, 3.47, DECISIONS #4)
9. **Payable = 92,197**

## Comparison with the settlement letter
| Letter deduction | Amount | Verdict | Correct amount | Why |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| Claim not admissible: Hernia 24-month specific waiting period not completed (Clause 6.3) | 99,000 | disputable | 0 | Inception 10-Jan-2024 to admission 20-Aug-2026 is >30 months continuous cover, so the 24-month wait (6.3 i.12) was complete. |

- Insurer paid: 0 ; gold payable: 92,197 ; difference (payable - paid): 92,197
- Overall: **disputable**

## Notes
Rejection wrong unless the SI was enhanced or cover broken - nothing in the documents suggests either. Payable computed as for an admissible claim.
